vercel_adapter.state_note: Spec Ghost keeps no mutable server state — every scan is computed fresh from files on disk — so the serverless adapter needs no per-warm-instance state caveat. One documented divergence: methods other than GET/POST get 404 here, where the local BaseHTTPRequestHandler answers 501.
